card.name: Unit abbreviations just before a slash
card.fires_on: The last piece of a measurement unit such as mcg, mg, mmol or liters, right before a slash and a per-volume part like /dL, /L or /mL. It appears in lab values and concentrations.

modes.label: Unit ending before slash
modes.description: The final piece of mcg or mmol, completed just before /dL or /L.

modes.label: mg before per-volume
modes.description: The unit mg after a number or a concentration heading, followed by /mL or /dL.
modes.example: several hundred<< mg>>/dL. Conduct a thorough neurological examination

modes.label: Spelled-out unit
modes.description: A written-out unit word that leads into 'per' a volume.

card.writes: It seems to push toward a per-volume unit next, and away from words like dimension or units.
card.plain: It fires on the mass part of a concentration unit, such as the mcg in mcg/dL, just before the per-volume part.
